name: dbsense-ai
description: DBSense AI - Autonomous Database Intelligence through Agentic RAG

scripts.ai:install: cd ai-layer && python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run frontend:install && npm run backend:install && npm run ai:install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run frontend:dev" "npm run backend:dev" "npm run ai:dev"
